title: Payment Application and Credit Reasons for Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services Charges
content:
**Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** keeps each resident therapy charge on its own, and every payment and every credit names the charge it applies to.

## Ledger policy

> A payment names the charge it pays and is applied only up to its open balance; a trust account transfer is posted only on the resident's per-bill authorization recorded with the trust account. A charge for a day in a Part A stay, for a denied service without a valid ABN, for a visit outside a signed plan or after an overdue progress report, for a deductible already met elsewhere, or billed in error is credited, naming the charge. Charges are billed monthly in arrears on the statement day and are due within the payment due days. A charge is credited once per reason.

## Payments

- **Open balance of a charge.** The amount of the charge less every payment and every credit naming it, as of the posting date.
- **Amount applied.** The lesser of the amount received and the charge's open balance.
- **Methods.** Check, ACH, card or trust transfer. A trust transfer is posted only on the resident's per-bill authorization recorded with the trust account.
- **What is recorded.** The charge paid, the payment method, the amount applied (a positive figure) and the date received.

Hypothetical figures: a charge of $15.26 has $6.00 already paid against it and no credit, so its open balance is $9.26. A payment of $12.40 naming it is applied at $9.26, the lesser of the two. A payment of $4.85 naming it is applied in full at $4.85.

## Credits

A charge falling under any of the following is credited, naming the charge. A charge is credited once per reason, judged on the system's record of credits already posted naming that charge.

| The charge is for | Credit reason recorded |
|---|---|
| A day in a Part A stay | Part A overlap |
| A denied service without a valid ABN | No valid ABN |
| A visit outside a signed plan | Uncertified visit |
| A visit after an overdue progress report | Progress report overdue |
| A deductible already met elsewhere | Deductible recalculated |
| An amount billed in error | Billing error |

A credit is recorded naming the charge, with its reason, the amount (a positive figure) and the posting date.

## Billing and due dates

Charges are billed monthly in arrears on the statement day, the 6th of the month, and are due within 30 calendar days after the statement date.
